tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders from joint ventures are not acceptable
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.
All the formats prescribed in the bid documents shall be filled in complete manner and shall be uploaded properly, signed by the tenderer.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty first day of March of succeeding year (both days inclusive).
If any of the dates mentioned above happen to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.
Any change / extensions, etc in the tender schedule (calendar of events) will not be published / advertised through news papers changes will be updated on/in KPP Portal only.
Typographical errors, if any, will not be the ground for any claims by the Bidder/ Firm/ Company.
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPP-procurement portal.

Under this contract, the rates quoted by the Man Power Service Provider shall be deemed to be INCLUSIVE of GST.. The increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the Man Power Service Provider is responsible.
The Conditions of the contract & Bid Document are published specifically in KPPP Portal.
The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever
The time stipulated for Providing Service is 12 Months.
Constitution or legal status of Tenderer : The intending bidder should furnish the copy of valid Registration Certificate issued from Labour Department GOK.

The Service Provider should quote the rates considering prevailing Minimum Wages as per Karnataka Minimum Wages act- 1954. In case of quoted rates are less than minimum wages will be liable for rejection
Applicable taxes will be deducted as per the Norms.
Earnest Money Deposit will have to be in any one of the forms as per the instructions in the financial bid document and shall have to be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of the tender.
The Employer reserves the rights to reject any or all tender without assigning any reasons.

Further particulars, if any, required by the Service Provider can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer PWD Division Dharwad during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened next working day will holds good in lieu of the dates mentioned
The Tenderer are should be present during opening of the tender and also submit the uploaded documents duly attested by the Gazetted Officer not below the Rank of Executive Engineer.

The Service Providers are instructed to submit only relevent information with records as required and specified in qualification criteria. any junk ,superfluous and unnecessary documents if uploaded will treated as misleading and such tenders are liable to be rejected
The Successful Tenderer shall have to be submitted 5% of Security Deposit on accepted tender amount in the form FDR in the name of Executive Engineer PWD Dharwad Division Dharwad
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2025-26 in the Technical Qualification Criteria

As per Government Circular No. FD/263/EXP-12/2022, Dated 11/05/2022 Tender Clause ITT 24.3. If Successful Bidder not made Agreement with Employer then the EMD Amount will be forfeited and Tender will Rejected
The age limit of the workers employed by the tenderers should be minimum 18 to 60 years
The Bidder Should Submit Outsource Employees Bank /EPF/ESI Details with valid documents and deduction of the same should be Submitted on every month.

If the contract is Stopping of Supplying of Services without any notice during the contract period or if there is a problem with the contract , the security deposit will be forfeited and a necessary action will be taken. The damage caused by the Service will be recovered from the Service Provider
The employee shall be literate and should be conversant with the local languages.
The Service Provider shall instruct its personnel to attend the duty neatly dressed with caution jacket

The Service Provider should provide all amenities to his personnel such as Identity card/badges etc., Service Provider should also take care of all safety and risk management of the personnel deployed during the period of contract.

The Service Provider shall provide suitable, eligible and acceptable personnel for the department and while recruiting, due weightage should be given to personnels with sufficient experience. The Service Provider shall check the antecedents of the personnels before hiring them and shall maintain their personnel details such as name, address (temporary/permanent) telephone No. etc

In case of an employee abstaining from work either on long leave or under other circumstances, the Service Provider shall immediately provide a suitable substitute so that work does not get hampered and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to accept or reject the services of any personnels provided by the Service Provider and demand for replacement, which has to be obliged by the Service Provider immediately.

The staff is the employee of the Service Provider and not of the Government Department. The Government Department shall at no time directly or indirectly employ the Service Provider staff for the services of any other nature or deal with any personnel in any capacity during the tenure of this contract.

The Service Provider shall regularly remit the EPF& ESI (both employers & employees contribution) contribution to Government as per existing rules and shall pay all the legitimate statutory and mandatory remittances to the concerned respective departments and produce the copy of the paid challans once in every 3 months (quarterly) & failing which payment for the succeeding months will be withheld by the Department.
The Service Provider shall produce the copies of the Service tax remittances made and quarterly Returns.
If two or more eligible bidders quoted the same rates then the selection of tenderer will done on the basis of lottery system.
The Government of Karnataka shall not be responsible in any way for the claims of regularization or any other benefit which is not mentioned in this Agreement.

The Personnels employed by the Service Provider should not be a member of the Trade union of the employees or take part directly or indirectly in any of the activities of union or association of the Govt. which are prejudicial in the interest of the employer
The Executive Engineer reserves the right to increase or decrease the total number of personnels as and when alternative arrangements are made by the Govt. without any prior notice.
EMD Rs. 12,200/- E Payment
The bidder shall not quote below APT else his tender will be rejected
Please refer terms of reference at Page.No. 20 & Condition no. (5. VI) i.e The Labour shall work on all days except the weekly rest and on National Holidays (January 26th, May 1st & August 15th )
